children: Producer prices in Luxembourg fell 2.1% year-on-year in July 2026, easing from a 3.2% decline in the previous month and marking the mildest decline since September 2025.
Deflation slowed for consumer goods (-6.8% vs -8.2% in June), while prices rebounded for intermediate goods (1.4% vs -0.7%) and continued to rise for capital goods (4.6% vs 3.8%).
Meanwhile, deflation deepened for energy goods (-15.5% vs -12.6%).
On a monthly basis, producer prices rose 1.3% in July, accelerating from a 0.4% increase in June.

title: Luxembourg Producer Prices Fall Least in 10 Months
